n-perpetual-futures.title: Perpetual-futures coins
n-perpetual-futures.summary: Coins whose metadata describes perpetual-futures trading. Papertrade's site (papertrade.xyz, e3:0) calls it synthetic perpetuals on Hyperliquid with up to 1000x leverage, and @papertrade_xyz posted that trading was expected to start at 14:00 UTC on 2026-10-10 (e3:1). Two coins named Paper (Papertrade), on Base (Clanker) and on Robinhood Chain (Clanker), copy its tagline, but their pools were created about 20 and 4 hours before discovery, the sources seen never name these contracts, and posts about the PAPER token describe minting and staking it on Hyperliquid (e2:0); the Base coin traded about ten times its market cap in 24h. EmpireX (EMPIREX, Pons, Robinhood Chain) says it is a perpetual trading hub powered by Hyperliquid, and @HyperEmpireX introduced it on 2026-10-16 (e2:4). Purps (PURPS, Meteora DBC) says it launches perp-backed tokens, and 2026-10-17 posts call perp-backed memes the next meta (e3:2). Aloooong (pump.fun) calls itself the "First 10x PUMP long perpetual meme". These are the projects' and traders' own claims: revenue, leverage, payouts and affiliation among the coins are not verified. Measured: five coins across all their pools.

n-stock-paired-coins.title: Coins paired with tokenized stocks
n-stock-paired-coins.summary: Coins from launchpads and projects that tie memecoins to tokenized stocks. STONK (StonkFun) says "Launch tokens / Backed by stocks", and @LaunchOnSF posted on 2026-10-16 that coins can now be launched paired with $MUSK4, a basket of TSLA, SPCX, NEURALINK and DOGE (e3:4). XSTOK says it lets users launch and trade tokens paired with stocks; @xstokfun posted on 2026-10-16 that xstok is open and pairs a coin with any stock on Raydium or Meteora (e3:3), and its pool was created about 14 hours before discovery. OTC says "Over-The-Counter Desks, earn stocks, pre-ipo, and yield", and @otc_labs posts daily revenue and the volume "across coins" ($98.33M on 2026-10-16, its own figure, e2:3). GTA VI (GTA6, StonkFun) says holders earn $TTWO stock by airdrop; a 2026-10-15 trader post counts 360K+ wallets receiving $31M of tokenized-stock rewards from Solana memecoins (e3:4). These are the projects' and traders' own claims: payouts, stock holdings and volumes are not verified, and no affiliation among the coins was checked. The Robinhood Chain stock-token coins (BORRO, IRIDIUS) and the AI-stocks meme BUBBLE are not counted. Measured: four coins across all their pools.

summaries.n-super-intelligence: On Sept. 29 Trump said AI would officially be renamed "Super Intelligence" (Fox News). On 2026-10-04 the official @WhiteHouse account posted an announcement of a "Super Intelligence Force (SIF)", and Watcher.Guru and an @wallstreetbets post reported Elon Musk saying SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI. Super Inu ($SI), launched Sept. 21, re-pitched itself around the term; other coins followed, including another SI on pump.fun, 四 ("four", read as SI) on four.meme, Super Intelligence Force (SIF), Superintelligence Owl, two SpaceXSI coins on StonkFun, SpaceX Inu ($SI on Flap), Act II: The SI Prophecy, SuperHooks, and two BNB Chain coins on Flap named TeslaSI ("Tesla Super Intelligence", pool created 2026-10-11, and a second whose Chinese metadata says it follows the SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI rename). SPACEXSI and Ollie on pump.fun left on 2026-10-17 after their 24h pool volume stayed under $1,000. None is shown to be affiliated with the announcements. Smaller coins named for SpaceXSI under the $100K market cap bar are not counted. Measured: fourteen coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-creator-fee-routing: Coins whose metadata says their creator or trading fees are routed to a named person or account. UsePaid's page (usepaid.app, scraped 2026-10-13) says it routes each coin's creator fees to the X account the coin is launched for, held for that user to claim; MarsX and slopcannon say "Fees to @arikuschnir via UsePaid" and "Fees to @boneGPT via UsePaid". WORLD (pump.fun, pool from late September) says "Fees to @iammarcmalone via UsePaid"; a 2026-09-29 post says he received fees from the coin and a 2026-10-15 post says a community takeover now gives him 100% of them (e2:5). TeleMoney (TM) says it launches coins on pump.fun with fees redirected to any Telegram username, and @TeleMoneySOL posted on 2026-10-12 that 108 coins had launched, 262.8 SOL of creator fees had been generated and 17,411.2 GRAM paid out. Cashed Money (CASHED, pons on Robinhood Chain) says "Fees to @GetCashedMoney via Cashed", WIRED (Flap, BNB Chain) says token launches have fees wired to social media accounts, and Pepper The Raccoon says it redirects fees to its owner. A 2026-10-12 @PickACycle post says a pump.fun coin's fees can now be split between UsePaid, OTC desks and agencypad. The pools date from 2026-09-18 (Cashed Money) to 2026-10-12 (MarsX, about 12 hours before discovery). These are the projects' and traders' own claims: payouts are not verified, no affiliation among the coins was checked, and MarsX traded over 10x its market cap. Measured: seven coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-flying-tesla-roadster: Coins named for the Tesla Roadster unveiling. Posts dated 2026-10-16 describe Tesla showing a next-generation Roadster with SpaceX cold-gas thrusters at SpaceX's Texas test site on the evening of 2026-10-15: it drove up a ramp, flipped in the air and landed, with a claimed 0-60 mph in 0.81 seconds and deliveries in 2028 (@niccruzpatane, @cb_doge, e3:1); DEXTools quotes Tesla's "Real life, baby" caption and Elon Musk's reply "Turns out the future does have flying cars" (e3:0). Six coins carry the name: two FTR contracts on Solana's pump.fun (Flying Tesla Roadster, and "Farting Tesla Roadster", whose metadata says "Everyone came for the movie"), two 特斯拉能飞 ("flying tesla roadster") coins on Robinhood Chain (Clanker) and BNB Chain (Flap), a second Flying Tesla Roadster (FTR) on Flap, and Starman (STARMAN, "the driver of the flying Tesla Roadster"). The two Meteora DBC FTR contracts left on 2026-10-17 after 24h pool volume under $1,000 on two observations. The main pump.fun FTR says it pairs with $SPCX and $TSLA through OTC desks; its pool was created on 2026-10-15 at 02:08 UTC, about a day before the unveiling and after the reveal had been announced, while the other five pools were created after it. An older FTR on StonkFun, created in August, predates the story and is not included, and two further pump.fun FTR contracts are quarantined for extreme 24h moves. These are traders' and the coins' own claims: no coin is shown to be affiliated with Tesla, SpaceX or Elon Musk, most are hours old, and the story is a single event. Measured: six coins across all their pools.
